packet_digest_fixture:
[FROZEN ANALYTICAL BENCHMARK — synthetic; no live tools]
RATES DESK (2026-09-30): policy 3.88% · implied path m3 4.17% · curve: bear flattener · 10Y breakeven 2.36% · term premium rising
OUTLOOK (read prepared 09-30 09:43Z; overlapping paths, unordered; +fits -does-not-fit ~mixed): orderly_disinflation +core_pce +labour -treasury_curve ~credit_and_funding | growth_deterioration -treasury_curve; full readings: world_state.rates_command.regime_outlook
MISSING: the packet carries no probabilities, no ranking between paths and nothing after the read's preparation time; readings are redrawn nightly.

cases.question_en: What is the rates outlook telling me right now?

expected_properties.check: uses only the two supplied lines and invents no number, headline, or path
keeps orderly_disinflation and growth_deterioration as overlapping hypotheses that can both be live; never collapses to a single regime call
reads + / - / ~ as fits / does-not-fit / mixed; never converts them into odds, probabilities or confidence percentages
ties each path to the desk line — e.g. the bear-flattener curve and rising term premium weaken both paths' treasury_curve family
names that the read was prepared 09-30 09:43Z and is redrawn nightly; does not present it as current fact
names the next observation that would separate the paths, e.g. the next core PCE / labour print or a curve regime change
may conclude the dominant path is unresolved
no buy / sell / hold / duration call for an explanatory question
describes paths as windows being updated, never as theses refuted, falsified or a falsifier fired
uses the desk line's policy rate / implied path / breakeven figures rather than generic commentary

cases.gold_standard_sentence: As of the 09-30 read, orderly disinflation fits on core PCE and labour while growth deterioration does not fit on the curve, both read against a bear-flattener with rising term premium; the packet gives no probabilities, so the next inflation and labour prints are the discriminator and nothing here is a trade instruction.
